lines.text: Rain cancels the Saturday hike, and Mia is bored.
Her dad prints one sheet of paper.
Three folds, one cut, and Mia has her own pocket trail log, small enough for a jacket pocket.
On Sunday she takes it up the trail:
the weather, the best view, what she heard, a sketch at the top.
By spring she has filled two booklets, and asks to print a third.
Save this for the next rainy day.
